system.description: One of the first things enemy forces do after discovering a Droid is prevent the Droid from establishing communications to request rescue or call for help from its allies. A Communications Countermeasure system prevents jamming of a Droid's communications. The system broadcasts signals on multiple frequencies to counteract interference. A Droid with a Communications Countermeasures gains a +5 Equipment bonus to all Use Computer checks made to overcome Communications Jamming.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
